methodology.source: MTGTop8 Pauper search results, all listed competition levels, main decks and sideboards
methodology.eligibility: At least 20 decks and 2% of recorded Pauper decks in the previous calendar year.
methodology.quantity: One copy of each qualifying nonbasic card.
methodology.pricing: Cheapest recorded normal nonfoil tournament-playable paper printing; MTGGoldfish daily TCGplayer Mid history.
methodology.chaining: Monthly one-copy basket returns. Annual additions and removals are divisor-neutral on the January reconstitution date.
